purpose: Public native qualification for exact approved host process admission through Harness
fixture_policy: Harness stages the exact ExecutionApproval in its host-only execution journal, opens a durable interaction whose action digest is the immutable request digest, and dispatches through NativeExecutionProvider after the authenticated operator decision.
assertions: operator inspection exposes exact executable, argv, cwd, and explicit environment without the operator credential or model content
wrong credentials and forged approval identities are denied
dispatch before approval is denied and produces no checkout side effect
approved dispatch runs the real host process and creates the exact checkout marker
re-dispatch after the durable receipt returns the succeeded outcome without spawning an unsafe duplicate
the process is hidden, stdin is closed, owned output is drained, and cleanup has a bounded forced termination fallback
boundaries: This scenario proves Harness host admission, operator authorization, exact action binding, real Windows process execution, and receipt replay.
It does not claim a secure remote private channel: the JSON-lines operator credential is process-local control input and must be protected by the embedding host.
The model fixture is deterministic and no sandbox is provided; workspace routing is not process confinement.
